title: Bowl-a-Rama
logline: Michael's 'team-building' bowling night becomes an office-versus-warehouse grudge match; Roy, after a strike, sets a wedding date on the spot, and Jim tells Michael, of all people, that he's in love with Pam.
outline: A: Michael turns team-building bowling into a grudge match with the warehouse, loses, and keeps the one secret that matters. B: Roy sets a wedding date in front of everyone; outside, Jim confesses to Michael. C: Kelly keeps score for Ryan, generously. Order: cold, A, B, A, C, A, B, A, B, C, A, tag
storySoFar: At Michael's team-building bowling night, the office lost to the warehouse (undefeated since 1998) despite three straight strikes from Kevin and his ball, Doris; Michael rolled a gutter ball on the last frame. After a strike, Roy set the wedding date on the spot: June tenth, and Pam said yes. In the parking lot Jim told Michael he's in love with Pam, and Michael is, for once, keeping the secret, badly. Kelly made Ryan MVP and kissed his cheek; Ryan is 'not not' dating her. Earlier: snowed in overnight, Jim and Pam shared a vending-machine dinner; Pam takes an art class Tuesdays; Angela secretly wrote the harsh survey comment and Dwight protected her; Jan kissed Michael and says it never happened; corporate will close Scranton or Stamford.

stateChanges.progress: Roy set the wedding for June 10; Jim confessed his love to Michael, who is keeping it secret
Kelly made Ryan bowling MVP and kissed his cheek; Ryan is 'not not' dating her

stateChanges.status: Michael knows Jim loves Pam and is trying to be a real vault

stateChanges.text: Kevin is a great bowler; his ball is named Doris
The warehouse hasn't lost a bowling game since 1998

scenes.recap: Michael practices bowling in the office with a roll of packing tape and the water cooler jugs.

beats.caption: sets up six empty water jugs like pins

beats.text: Watch the form, Dwight. Low. Smooth. Like a panther. Bowling.

beats.caption: rolls a tape roll, slips, and lands on one knee
the tape rolls under Stanley's desk

beats.text: Strike.
None of the jugs moved, Dwight.
Spiritually, Jim.

scenes.recap: Michael announces a team-building bowling night, office versus warehouse; Darryl warns them the warehouse hasn't lost since 1998.

beats.text: Tonight: team building. Bowl-a-Rama. The office versus the warehouse. For pride. And pizza.
Just so you know, the warehouse hasn't lost a game since 1998. We have shirts.
Well, the office has... heart. And Kevin. Kevin, you bowl?
I have my own ball. It's named Doris.

lines: Team building is about learning to trust each other. And crushing the warehouse.
Mostly the crushing. Darryl knows. We've talked.

scenes.recap: Pam says Roy has been looking forward to bowling all week; Jim says he bowls 'with dignity'.

beats.text: Roy's been talking about tonight all week. He's bringing his wrist brace.
Wow. A brace. That's... serious bowling.
Do you bowl?
I bowl with dignity. Which means badly, but with good posture.

scenes.recap: Michael trash-talks the warehouse; Darryl stays calm, and Roy bowls a strike on his first ball.

beats.text: SCRANTON BOWL-A-RAMA
Darryl, I hope your team likes losing. Because they're gonna... lose. A lot. At this.
Michael, we're bowling. Relax. Have a pretzel.

beats.caption: bowls a strike and points at the pins

beats.text: Luck. Pure luck. Next I'll show you skill.

beats.caption: bowls with enormous force; the ball hops into the next lane

beats.text: I'm going to get a beer.

scenes.recap: Kelly keeps score and gives Ryan bonus points for being cute.

beats.caption: writes on the scorecard with a glitter pen

beats.text: Ryan, that was a seven, but I gave you a ten. For form. And for your arms.
You can't do that. It's math.
It's my math. I'm the scorekeeper.

lines: Kelly's not my girlfriend. She's a coworker who is very... present.

scenes.recap: Down eighty pins, Michael gives a war speech; Kevin and Doris bowl three strikes in a row.

beats.text: We're down by eighty pins, Michael.
Huddle. Listen to me. They have shirts. We have something better. We have each other. And Kevin.

beats.caption: bowls a perfect strike with a purple ball named Doris
bowls a third, and kisses the ball

beats.text: Kevin is... good at something?

lines: I've bowled every Thursday since I was nine. Doris is my third ball.
The first two retired. Doris is a champion.

scenes.recap: After another strike, Roy pumped up, sets the wedding date on the spot: June tenth. Everyone cheers, and Jim smiles too late.

beats.text: Pam! You know what? June tenth. Let's do it. The wedding. June tenth. I'm serious.
Really? Like, a date date?
Date date. It's been three years. Let's go.
Okay. Yes! June tenth!

scenes.recap: Michael needs a spare to tie the game in the last frame, and misses; Darryl is gracious about it.

beats.text: FINAL FRAME
Michael, you need a spare to tie. The fate of the office is in your hands.

beats.caption: bowls slowly, very slowly, directly into the gutter

beats.text: Good game, Michael. Y'all were closer than last year. Last year was a massacre.
Thank you, Darryl. We'll get you next year. Or the year after. Or Kevin will.

scenes.recap: Outside, Michael finds Jim alone; Jim tells him he's in love with Pam, and Michael promises to be a real vault.

beats.text: Jim! Great night. Even though we lost. What are you doing out here?
I'm in love with Pam.
Oh. Oh no. Does she know?
No. And she just set a date. So you can't tell anyone. Ever. Michael.
I'm a vault.
Michael.
A real vault. I promise. Not a Dwight vault.

scenes.recap: Kelly declares Ryan MVP and kisses his cheek; Ryan doesn't hate it.

beats.caption: hands Ryan the scorecard with 'MVP' written in glitter

beats.text: You're the MVP. Officially. I decided.
I bowled a ninety.

beats.caption: kisses Ryan on the cheek and runs off

lines: She kissed me on the cheek. I'm not dating Kelly.
I'm... not not dating Kelly. I don't know. It was a good game.

scenes.recap: Dwight asks what Jim said outside; Michael, heroically, says nothing.

beats.text: What were you and Jim talking about in the parking lot? Was it a plot? Against me?
Nothing. Bowling. Shoes. Shoe sizes. Jim is a twelve.

lines: I have the biggest secret of my life, and I'm not telling anyone.
This is the hardest thing I've ever done. Including the gutter ball.

scenes.recap: The next morning, Michael congratulates Pam on the date, very carefully, and says too much about saying nothing.

beats.text: Pam. Congratulations on June tenth. That's all I'm going to say. I know nothing else. About anything.
Okay... thanks?
Okay. Good. Vault. Bye.
